notes.title: Small update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
By popular demand we added 2 small features ːsteamthumbsupː

-Remove Censor Option
Now you can remove the censor blur from the nude skin from options menu.

https://i.imgur.com/rgaQlqF.jpg


-Max FPS option
Due some comments we recieved regarding performance we added a max fps option to adjust GPU performance.
https://i.imgur.com/xNW3Xsf.png

We hope you are enjoying the game! 

See you on the next update,

Mitsuki team
